nodes.name: configmap.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm-templated ConfigMap providing the Pebble ACME test server configuration along with its localhost serving certificate and private key, including custom 123h and 456h certificate profiles for cert-manager tests.
nodes.languageNotes: Embeds a long-lived self-signed localhost certificate and RSA key inline, and renders profile validityPeriod values with Helm's mul function.

nodes.name: deployment.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm-templated Deployment running the Pebble ACME test server on port 14000 with the mounted Pebble config, strict-mode toggle, HTTPS readiness probe, and values-driven resources and node selection.
nodes.languageNotes: Readiness probing targets Pebble's /dir endpoint over HTTPS; nodeSelector is rendered conditionally from values.

nodes.name: service.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm-templated Service mapping external TCP port 443 to the Pebble container's HTTPS ACME endpoint on port 14000.
